[quote=western_view;60067381][spoiler=The Election Ends, and Anarchry Begins][b][i]Western View Paper, Front Page[/i][/b]
Today the results from the election are in, and Mack Messiaon has won, as predicted. Mack has run for Head Council for 11 years, and 10 of them were against his younger brother Tony. Mack has already gone into action, banning any protests, and forcing anyone between the ages of 18 and 65, without a disability, to join the army, but mothers with children under the age of 16 are allowed to stay until their children come of age. Mack has also banned all forms of non-government media, as well as bringing back the death penalty and the torture penalty. This has come to shock to many because he said he would do anything to protect the citizens of Western View, but in previous campaigns he said he would protect the rights of Western View, thus he could be considered a liar. This shall be the last edition of the magazine before Mack Messiaon bans our paper.

[b]The Western View Paper, Page 2[/b]
Yesterday, not only were Wessernian and Kolionian jets stolen, Hatzur Zatsugi pretended to be the government in a letter and claimed that he stole the jets, also, rioters from Eastornia-Kolionia broke into the capital and stormed the place, many government officials and police men were hurt. Also many protesters had signs saying "Hatzur Zatsugi is better than you fools" or "Get the foreigners out" in fact their was one sign saying "We support Hatzur Zatsugi". This is most likely the reason why Mack Messioan banned public protests, though it really is only cause more violent protests, and many of the conscripted, and some no conscripted units have walked away from their training camps, or other bases, to apparently join Hatzur Zatsugi. The known number of people supporting Hatzur Zatsugi has risen from 13,000 to 26,000, and people estimate that there are over 40,000 people supporting Hatzur.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=To Little To Late][b][i][u]22:13 at Gartun Von Jullston Stein, weather is very stormy.[/u][/i][/b]
Pilots clammer on to their wet K-90s, K-110s, K-101s, K-120s, and K-99s, most are not happy about what they have to do. This will be a sad mission.(OOC: K-90=Junkers Ju 88 but with jets and the wings are on top of the fuselage, K-110=Bf-109 but with jets configured like the Me-262, K-101s=Bf 190 but with jets like the Mig 15, K-120=Bf 110 but with jets where the propellors would be, and K-99=Me 111 but with wings on top of the fuselage and jets where the propellers would be.) One by one they takeoff, and it's not just Gartun Von Jullston Stein, every [i]Stein[/i] (Airfield) in Eastornia-Kolionia is awake, and filled with the sounds of jet engines. The K-110s, K-101s, and K-120s are only there to protect against rouge pilots, because the government has been paid handsomely by an anonymous figure. By the time all planes are in the air it's almost midnight, it'll take another 15 or more minutes for all the planes to get to their target points to start laying their payload. Each [i]Grenste[/i] (Unit Air/Air Unit) is just a line of bombers with the fighter encircling the bombers. When they're all lined up, with centimeters of room between the wingtips, they start. Each row drops their bombs but stays in formation, since their are usually other bombers to hit other parts. The northern most bombers are instructed to gain altitude, and circle around towards their airfield. The chain leaves nothing spared. Many people are still sleeping in their houses when the bombs drop, while others are unaware of the impending doom. Luckily around 1 million citizens of the country fled, though most of them were rich people and government officials who had advanced warning of the bombs, yet some people evacuated without being told to because they knew the government didn't care about them, in fact the government doesn't care about anyone who doesn't give them enough money to last a life time, or who serves against the threats that could destroy this country. The armed forces were moved to locations outside the border thus they weren't hit, that includes all (except Baladullan) forces because they were told in advance, but Baladullan forces never got the message because the anonymous figure from before had paid them not to tell the biggest threat to Hatzur Zatsugi and his plans, luckily most of them were in caves during the night so only a few of them got injured. Of the 62 million people in Eastornia-Kolionia, 1 million people fled before the planes were even in the air, all 20 million men in the armed forces fled, but 43 million died, thus the population is down to around 22 million.[/spoiler]
